grammar_title: 被动语态(过去完成被动·过去进行被动)
source: 上外版选择性必修第一册 Unit 3 Grammar in Use:Passives(past perfect passive & past continuous passive)。句子地道、围绕探险/航海/极地主题、时间状语唯一判定被动时态、答案唯一(选项排除其他成立项)。

points.point: 过去完成被动 had been done(过去某动作之前已被完成)
points.overview: 表示在过去某个时间/动作之前,某事已经被做完。结构 had been + 过去分词。常与 before/by the time/when（先发生）等连用:The ship had been crushed before they escaped.

points.point: 过去进行被动 was/were being done(过去某时正在被进行)
points.overview: 表示过去某一时刻某事正在被进行。结构 was/were being + 过去分词。常与 when/while/at that moment（同时点)连用:The boat was being repaired when the storm hit.

points.point: 两者辨析 + by 短语 / 含情态的被动
points.overview: 根据时间状语判定:某动作之前已完成→had been done;过去某刻正在进行→was/were being done;by 引出动作执行者;情态动词的被动用 modal + be done。

questions.stem: By the time Shackleton set out, twenty-eight men ____ from the applicants.
questions.explanation: By the time + 过去动作,选拔在那之前已完成 → 过去完成被动 had been + done。

questions.stem: Before the storm hit, the lifeboats ____ and made ready on the deck.
questions.explanation: Before + 过去动作,准备在那之前已完成 → had been + done。

questions.stem: When the men reached the island, all their food ____ already.
questions.explanation: already 强调在到达这一过去时点前食物已吃完 → had been + done。

questions.stem: The route across the mountains ____ on foot by anyone before that day.
questions.explanation: before that day 指过去时点之前,从未被穿越过 → 过去完成被动否定 had never been + done。

questions.stem: By 1915 the ship ____ completely by the moving ice.
questions.explanation: By 1915 表示到那个过去时间点为止,包围已完成 → had been + done。

questions.stem: The captain found that his orders ____ before he even returned to camp.
questions.explanation: before he returned 之前命令已被执行 → had been + done。

questions.stem: Two months earlier the broken ship ____ to the freezing sea.
questions.explanation: Two months earlier 指更早的过去,弃船动作已完成 → had been + done。

questions.stem: When help finally came, three of the tents ____ by the wind.
questions.explanation: 在 help came 这一过去时点之前帐篷已被吹倒 → had been + done。

questions.stem: Every survivor was amazed that the message ____ to the station before nightfall.
questions.explanation: before nightfall 这一过去界限之前消息已送达 → had been + done。

questions.stem: By the second winter, the crew realised that they ____ by the rest of the world.
questions.explanation: By the second winter 表示到过去那个点为止已被遗忘 → had been + done。

questions.stem: The diary showed that a route ____ long before the men left the island.
questions.explanation: long before + 过去动作,计划早已被定好 → had been + done。

questions.stem: After the boat sank, they learned that warm clothes ____ on board the night before.
questions.explanation: the night before 指更早的过去,衣服已被落下 → had been + done。

questions.stem: The rescue boat ____ by the Chilean government before the captain set off again.
questions.explanation: before the captain set off 之前船已被提供 → had been + done。

questions.stem: When the sun rose, every man saw that the camp ____ by a thick layer of snow.
questions.explanation: 在 sun rose 这一过去时点之前营地已被埋住 → had been + done。

questions.stem: The explorer was proud that nobody ____ during the whole long expedition.
questions.explanation: the whole expedition 结束(过去)前无人丧生 → 过去完成被动 had been + done。

questions.stem: By the time the ice melted, the lifeboats ____ down to the water's edge.
questions.explanation: By the time + 过去动作,救生艇在那之前已被拖到水边 → had been + done。

questions.stem: He told us that the photographs ____ before the ship finally went down.
questions.explanation: before the ship went down 之前照片已被拍下 → had been + done。

questions.stem: The men were relieved that a fire ____ by the time they crawled into the hut.
questions.explanation: by the time they crawled in 之前火已被点着 → had been + done。

questions.stem: Before dawn broke, the heavy sledge ____ across the frozen ground.
questions.explanation: Before dawn broke 这一过去界限之前雪橇已被拉过去 → had been + done。

questions.stem: By the next morning the wet ropes ____ as hard as iron.
questions.explanation: By the next morning 指到过去那个早晨为止绳子已被冻硬 → had been + done。

questions.stem: Great efforts ____ to free the ship when the ice suddenly broke in half.
questions.explanation: when 引出过去某刻,努力正在被进行 → 过去进行被动 were being + done。

questions.stem: The lifeboat ____ when a huge wave struck it from the side.
questions.explanation: when 引出过去同一时点,修理正在被进行 → was being + done。

questions.stem: While the supplies ____ onto the boats, the wind began to rise.
questions.explanation: While + 过去进行,补给正在被搬上船 → were being + done。

questions.stem: At that very moment the tents ____ against the freezing wind.
questions.explanation: At that very moment 强调过去某刻正在进行 → were being + done。

questions.stem: The injured man's leg ____ when the doctor's hands grew too cold to work.
questions.explanation: when 引出过去同一时点,治疗正在被进行 → was being + done。

questions.stem: As the documentary explained, the explorers ____ to the very limits of human endurance.
questions.explanation: 叙述过去那段时间持续正在被推向极限 → were being + done。

questions.stem: When I looked out of the hut, the dogs ____ for the long journey ahead.
questions.explanation: When I looked out 引出过去某刻,套挽具正在被进行 → were being + done。

questions.stem: The captain's plan ____ over and over while the men waited on the ice.
questions.explanation: while + 过去进行,计划正在被反复讨论 → was being + done。

questions.stem: Just as the storm reached the boat, the sails ____ to slow it down.
questions.explanation: Just as 引出过去同一时点,船帆正在被放下 → were being + done。

questions.stem: While fresh water ____ from the melting snow, the men sang to keep warm.
questions.explanation: While + 过去进行,淡水正在被收集 → was being + done。

questions.stem: The wireless ____ when the last of the batteries finally died.
questions.explanation: when 引出过去某刻,无线电正在被使用 → was being + done。

questions.stem: At nine o'clock the heavy boat ____ across the rocks towards the open sea.
questions.explanation: At nine o'clock 指过去具体时刻正在进行 → was being + done。

questions.stem: While the route ____ on the map, a fresh snowstorm closed in.
questions.explanation: While + 过去进行,路线正在被标在地图上 → was being + done。

questions.stem: The frozen meat ____ slowly over the fire when a gust blew the flames out.
questions.explanation: when 引出过去同一时点,肉正在被加热 → was being + done。

questions.stem: As night fell, the last messages ____ down in the captain's log.
questions.explanation: As night fell 引出过去某刻正在进行 → were being + done。

questions.stem: The sick sailor ____ below deck while the others fought the rising waves.
questions.explanation: while + 过去进行,病人正在被照料 → was being + done。

questions.stem: When the rescuers arrived, a signal fire ____ on the highest point of the island.
questions.explanation: When the rescuers arrived 引出过去某刻,信号火正在被维持 → was being + done。

questions.stem: While the photographs ____ from the wreck, the ice cracked beneath their feet.
questions.explanation: While + 过去进行,照片正在被抢救 → were being + done。

questions.stem: At dawn the small boat ____ towards the distant whaling station.
questions.explanation: At dawn 指过去某刻正在进行,小船正在被划 → was being + done。

questions.stem: While the deck ____ clear of snow, a huge wave swept right over the men.
questions.explanation: While + 过去进行,甲板正在被清扫 → was being + done。

questions.stem: The expedition ship ____ by the accident long before it reached the sea.
questions.explanation: long before + 过去动作,延误早已发生 → 过去完成被动 had been + done。

questions.stem: Preparations ____ for the rescue when news of the storm arrived.
questions.explanation: when 引出过去同一时点,准备正在被进行 → 过去进行被动 were being + done。

questions.stem: Every member of the crew ____ by Shackleton himself before the voyage began.
questions.explanation: before the voyage began 之前已被本人挑选,by 引出执行者 → had been + done。

questions.stem: When we got there, the wounded explorer ____ by two of his friends.
questions.explanation: When we got there 引出过去某刻,正被两位朋友抬着 → was being + done。

questions.stem: The whole story ____ in his diary years before it was finally published.
questions.explanation: years before + 过去动作,故事早已被记录 → had been + done。

questions.stem: The signal ____ by the watchman the moment the rescue boat appeared.
questions.explanation: the moment 引出过去同一时点,信号正被升起,by 引出执行者 → was being + done。

questions.stem: Nothing ____ public about the men until they had safely come home.
questions.explanation: until 之前(过去)什么都没被公开 → had been + done。

questions.stem: Heavy sledges ____ over the mountains by the exhausted men at that time.
questions.explanation: at that time 指过去某刻正在进行,by 引出执行者 → were being + done。

questions.stem: Anyone left in that place ____ to death, the captain knew, unless help came.
questions.explanation: 情态语气表对将来后果的判断 → 情态被动 would be + done。

questions.stem: The captain warned that the boat ____ by the rocks if they steered too close.
questions.explanation: if 条件下的可能后果 → 情态被动 might be + done。

questions.stem: By the time the sun came out, the broken mast ____ with rope and wood.
questions.explanation: By the time + 过去动作,桅杆在那之前已被修好 → had been + done。

questions.stem: As the camera turned, fresh supplies ____ onto the tiny lifeboat by the sailors.
questions.explanation: As the camera turned 引出过去某刻正在进行,by 引出执行者 → were being + done。

questions.stem: The route ____ on foot by anyone in history before Shackleton's men crossed it.
questions.explanation: before + 过去动作,历史上从未被徒步探索过 → 过去完成被动否定 had never been + done。

questions.stem: While the documentary ____ , old sailors shared memories of the great voyage.
questions.explanation: While + 过去进行,纪录片正在被拍摄 → was being + done。

questions.stem: The plan to cross the island ____ by the captain before anyone else woke up.
questions.explanation: before anyone woke up 之前计划已被想出,by 引出执行者 → had been + done。

questions.stem: The frightened sailor felt the ship ____ down into the depths of each wave.
questions.explanation: 感官动词后表过去某刻正在被进行 → was being + done。

questions.stem: All the lifeboats ____ from the wreck long before the ship sank for good.
questions.explanation: long before + 过去动作,救生艇早已被救出 → had been + done。

questions.stem: The good news ____ across the deck just as the men sat down to rest.
questions.explanation: just as 引出过去同一时点,好消息正在被传开 → was being + done。

questions.stem: Without his leadership, the men ____ on that island, the historian noted.
questions.explanation: 对过去未发生情况的推测 → 情态完成被动 might have been + done。

questions.stem: The brave story ____ down from sailor to sailor long after the captain died.
questions.explanation: long after + 过去动作,在更早过去之前故事已被代代相传 → had been + done。
